cohort: The study participants included 10 recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL) patients with positive anti-trophoblast antibodies (ATAb) receiving IVIL, 2 ATAb-positive RPL patients managed expectantly, and 2 healthy ATAb-negative volunteers.
finding: Intralipid infusions significantly reduced anti-trophoblast antibody (ATAb) activities in ATAb-positive recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL) patients, with most pregnancies proceeding to healthy live births.
gest_age: Healthy newborns were >=37 gestational weeks, with abortions occurring at 6+3gw, 7+4gw, and 7+6gw.
